text: Do you know that your dreams can actually stop you?

If you have that one big idea that you carry with yourself for years, the things that can change your life, you would not dare to test it. Because the moment you do it, you will figure out if it's a real thing or it's just hope. And you don't want to give up hope because hope feels so good. And instead of relying on one idea in your head, why wouldn't you rely on one amazing thing? Why wouldn't you decide that you will not stop until you figure
